name: Jiyuujizai ni Ero Saimin ~DameDame no Ore demo Bishoujo Taimashi to Yarimakuri!~
original_name: 自由自在にエロ催眠～ダメダメの俺でも美少女退魔士と犯りまくり!～
source:
Things always backfired for Rick Kamisawa.

That looked like it might change when he was invited to the Urban Legend Club, a hangout for cute girls who really liked demons and occult mysteries, but it turned out to be much more than that. The girls were Exorcist Knights, and Rick was recruited for his uncanny demon magnetism.

He was the bait. How disappointing.

Things always backfired.

While he adjusted to life with the Club, Rick found a discarded book called "The Tome of Seduction".
Like many urban legends lately it proved that mind control was real, and that minds could be controlled if you knew the right steps.
With this book, Rick saw the potential to warp the reality around him.

He was no exorcist, but he could be a hypnotist...
Master over his teachers, his classmates, and the beautiful girls of the Club.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE146045.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
对于Rick Kamisawa来说，事情总是适得其反。

当他被邀请加入都市传奇俱乐部时，这种情况看起来可能会改变，这是一个真正喜欢恶魔和神秘事物的可爱女孩们的聚会场所，但事实证明，情况远不止于此。女孩们是驱魔骑士，瑞克因其不可思议的恶魔磁力而被招募。

他就是诱饵。多么令人失望啊。

事情总是适得其反。

当瑞克适应俱乐部的生活时，他发现了一本被丢弃的书，名叫《诱惑之书》。
就像最近的许多都市传说一样，它证明了精神控制是真实的，如果你知道正确的步骤，思想就可以被控制。
通过这本书，里克看到了扭曲他周围现实的潜力。

他不是驱魔师，但他可以是催眠师……
掌控他的老师、同学和俱乐部的漂亮女孩。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE146045.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
